title: Footprint-seq: a simple method to quantitatively map in vitro protein-DNA interactions on a genome-wide scale at high spatial resolution
authors: Archer J. Wang; Anne M. Stringer; Joseph T. Wade
one_liner_zh: 该文提出Footprint-seq测序方法，定量绘制体外蛋白-DNA互作图谱并推断解离常数，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但以实验方法为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，对TF-DNA机制研究借鉴有限。
abstract: Protein–DNA interactions underlie essential cellular processes. The position and/or strength of protein interactions with DNA have historically been studied for short DNA regions using in vitro assays. More recent microarray- and sequencing-based assays have been developed to map protein-DNA interactions on a genome-wide scale. However, these genome-scale methods offer limited spatial resolution and have not been effectively applied to determine dissociation constants for individual sites. Here, we introduce Footprint-seq, a simple, sequencing-based method that maps and quantifies protein–DNA interactions in vitro with high resolution on a genome-wide scale. Footprint-seq measures local protection from transposition in the presence of a DNA-binding protein. Using the well-studied Escherichia coli DNA-binding protein, CRP, as a test case, we show that Footprint-seq detects CRP binding sites with high resolution across plasmid or genomic DNA. Moreover, we show that Footprint-seq enables inference of dissociation constants for hundreds of genomic sites. Thus, Footprint-seq provides a rapid, accessible, and quantitative method for mapping protein–DNA interactions in bacteria and other systems.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-DNA相互作用是基本细胞过程的基础。历史上，蛋白质与DNA相互作用的位置和/或强度通常通过体外实验对短DNA区域进行研究。近年来，基于微阵列和测序的方法已被开发用于在全基因组范围内绘制蛋白质-DNA相互作用图谱。然而，这些全基因组方法提供的空间分辨率有限，且尚未有效应用于确定单个位点的解离常数。在此，我们介绍了Footprint-seq，一种简单、基于测序的方法，能够在全基因组范围内以高分辨率绘制和量化体外蛋白质-DNA相互作用。Footprint-seq测量在DNA结合蛋白存在下转座作用的局部保护。以研究充分的大肠杆菌DNA结合蛋白CRP作为测试案例，我们表明Footprint-seq能够以高分辨率检测质粒或基因组DNA上的CRP结合位点。此外，我们证明Footprint-seq能够推断数百个基因组位点的解离常数。因此，Footprint-seq为在细菌及其他系统中绘制蛋白质-DNA相互作用提供了一种快速、易用且定量的方法。
